title: 雨后的屋顶
short: Rain is coming. We need to repair the roof. One board is broken. Replace that board, but keep the dry boards. A cloth cover is only a temporary solution.
text: The cottage stayed dry last night, but one roof board has cracked. We should repair the roof before the next shower. Replace only the damaged board; the other boards are still reliable. A cloth cover may help for an hour, but it is only a temporary solution. Save the sound wood for the porch.
zh: 雨快来了，屋顶有一块木板裂了。只换坏板，其余还能用的木板留给门廊。布罩只能临时挡雨。
question: 先处理哪一处？
cue: Replace the broken board. Keep the dry wood beside the cottage.
cue_options: 坏板换掉，好木料留在屋边
sentence: Replace the broken board before the rain.

title: 靠岸的小路
short: The boat will deliver wood today. Gather the loose stones from the path. Rope is scarce, so repairing the landing area is our first priority. The flowers can wait.
text: A boat will deliver fresh wood this afternoon. Before it arrives, gather the loose stones that block the path. Rope is scarce, and we cannot repair every corner today. Our priority is a safe landing area. Once the crew can reach the cottage without slipping, we can return to the flower beds.
zh: 船下午送木料。先清理路上的碎石。绳子不够，优先修好停船区，让船员安全走到木屋，花坛稍后再做。
question: 绳子先用在哪里？
cue: Clear the path first. Then carry the new wood to the landing area.
cue_options: 先清路，再把木料搬到停船区
sentence: Clear the path before the boat arrives.

title: 门廊下的旧椅子
short: An ordinary chair sits beneath the porch. Its frame is strong. We can restore the seat and preserve the frame. Do not throw the whole chair away.
text: We found an ordinary wooden chair beneath the porch. The seat has worn out, but the frame is still strong. Instead of throwing the chair away, restore its seat and preserve the useful frame. It will give the boat crew a comfortable place to rest. Keep the chair under the roof so that rain cannot reach it.
zh: 门廊下有把旧木椅，椅面坏了，但框架还结实。修复椅面，保留框架，再把它放到屋檐下避雨。
question: 旧椅子怎么处理？
cue: Put the repaired chair beneath the porch, away from the rain.
sentence: Keep the chair beneath the porch.

title: 给伙伴留个位置
short: Two friends will visit. Adapt the porch to accommodate them. A versatile folding table leaves room for a bench. We can expand the porch later; today, move the large crates.
text: Two friends are arriving on the next boat. We can adapt the porch to accommodate them without rebuilding the cottage. A versatile folding table can serve both meals and repairs. Move the large crates inside to make space for a bench. If more visitors arrive later, we can expand the porch, but there is no need to do everything today.
zh: 两位朋友快到了。先把大箱子搬进屋，用折叠桌和长椅腾出空间。以后客人多了，再扩建门廊。
question: 今天怎样腾出座位？
cue: Move the crates inside. Leave enough space for the bench.
cue_options: 箱子搬进屋，长椅移出去
箱子放屋外，长椅搬进屋
箱子搬进屋，给长椅留空间
sentence: Move the crates inside the cottage.

title: 让叶片转起来
short: The mill turns slowly. The rough surface of one part causes friction. Make it smooth to reduce friction. Avoid the moving sails while you work. Stop the mill first.
text: The wind is strong enough, yet the mill turns slowly. A rough surface inside the mechanism is rubbing against another part. We can reduce friction by making that surface smooth. To avoid an accident, stop the sails before opening the cover. Adding more weight will not solve the problem; careful repair will.
zh: 风够大，风车却转得慢，是内部粗糙表面互相摩擦。先停风车，再把那处磨平，不能在叶片转动时维修。
question: 动手维修前先做什么？
cue: Stop the sails. Smooth the rough surface before starting the mill again.
cue_options: 先停叶片，磨平后再启动
sentence: Stop the mill before opening the cover.

title: 接住每一桶水
short: We can obtain water from the pump. The small tank has limited capacity. Use an efficient pipe with no leaks. One full tank is adequate for the garden today.
text: The new pump helps us obtain water from the shore. However, the storage tank has a limited capacity. An efficient system needs a sealed pipe so that water reaches the tank instead of leaking onto the path. One full tank is adequate for today. When it is full, close the valve rather than letting the water overflow.
zh: 水泵能从岸边抽水，但水箱容量有限。用不漏水的管道接入水箱，一箱够今天浇花，满了就关阀，别任它溢出。
question: 为什么要用不漏水的管子？
cue: Fill the tank, then close the valve. Save the water for the garden.
sentence: Close the valve when the tank is full.

title: 大风前的支撑
short: A storm is coming. The tall support is fragile. Reinforce it so the mill can withstand the wind. Our main constraint is time. Repair the support before painting the door.
text: The next storm may bring stronger winds. A fragile support beneath the mill needs attention if the structure is to withstand the weather. Reinforce the support with the spare beams. Our main constraint is time, so painting the door must wait. Strengthening the part that carries the load matters more than changing its colour.
zh: 风暴快来了，风车下面的支撑不够牢。时间紧，先用备用梁加固承重处，刷门漆可以等。
question: 有限时间先用来做什么？
cue: Use the spare beams to reinforce the support. Paint the door later.
cue_options: 备用梁加固支撑，晚点刷漆
sentence: Reinforce the support before the storm.

title: 风停的时候
short: Wind speed can fluctuate. A tank helps sustain the water supply when the wind stops. Stored water can mitigate a short shortage and keep the supply consistent. Fill the tank while the mill runs.
text: Wind speed can fluctuate throughout the day. The garden needs a more consistent supply of water than the weather can provide on its own. A storage tank helps sustain the supply during calm periods. Keeping some water in reserve can mitigate a short shortage. Fill the tank while the mill is running, and use the stored water when the sails stop.
zh: 风速会波动，花园却需要稳定供水。有风时储水，无风时用储备水，能缓解短时间的缺水。
question: 无风时花园用哪来的水？
cue: Store water while the wind blows. Use the reserve when the sails stop.
cue_options: 有风时存水，停风时用储备
有风时用储备，停风时存水
sentence: Use stored water when the wind stops.

title: 把苗分开种
short: Seeds are abundant, but sunny space is scarce. Gather the empty pots. Space is a useful resource. Leave a gap between the pots so that every plant can receive light.
text: We have abundant seeds, but space in the sunny corner is scarce. Gather the empty pots before deciding where to put them. Space is a resource too: packing every pot into one tight row will leave some plants in shade. Leave a small gap between the pots and keep the taller plants behind the shorter ones.
zh: 种子多，向阳的地方少。先收集空花盆，盆间留缝，高的放后面，让每株都能见光。
question: 花盆之间为什么要留出空隙？
cue: Leave a gap between the pots. Put the tall plants at the back.
sentence: Leave a gap between the pots.
sentence_zh: 在花盆之间留一道空隙。

title: 给土壤盖一层
short: Water is essential for the seedlings. Cover the soil with dry leaves to retain moisture. Add roughly one thin layer. Growth is gradual, so do not dig up the roots every morning.
text: The seedlings need water, but the soil dries quickly in the sun. A thin layer of dry leaves can help it retain moisture. Add roughly enough leaves to cover the bare surface without burying the stems. Water remains essential, and growth will be gradual. Check the soil gently instead of disturbing the roots every morning.
zh: 幼苗需要水，薄薄一层干叶能帮土壤保湿。盖住裸土即可，别埋茎。生长需要时间，不要每天把根翻出来检查。
question: 给土壤铺干叶有什么用？
cue: Cover the bare soil with a thin layer of leaves. Keep the stems clear.
sentence: Keep the leaves away from the stems.
sentence_zh: 让覆盖的叶子离开茎部。

title: 分好今天的水
short: We must allocate water between two beds. Give a larger proportion to the dry bed. Replenish the tank afterwards. Otherwise, there will be no water for the evening.
text: One garden bed is much drier than the other. We need to allocate the remaining water carefully rather than give both beds the same amount. Send a larger proportion to the dry bed, then replenish the tank while the wind is still strong. Otherwise, we may have nothing left for the young plants in the evening.
zh: 两块苗床中有一块更干，要给它多分些水。浇完趁风还大补满水箱，不然傍晚幼苗会没水用。
question: 今天的水怎么分？
cue: Water the dry bed first. Replenish the tank before the wind drops.
cue_options: 先浇湿的那块，再等停风
sentence: Water the dry bed before refilling the tank.
sentence_zh: 补满水箱前先浇干苗床。

title: 夜里降温了
short: The older plants are resilient. The young seedlings are susceptible to cold. Anticipate a chilly night and cover only the young plants. Leaving them outside may have a serious consequence.
text: The weather report suggests a cold night. The older plants are resilient, but the young seedlings are susceptible to sudden changes in temperature. We can anticipate the problem and move the youngest pots beneath the shelter. Leaving every plant exposed may have a serious consequence. Keep the cover loose enough to let air pass through.
zh: 夜里可能降温。大株较耐受，幼苗更容易受冷。把最小的花盆移到遮棚下，覆盖物留通气缝。
question: 先保护哪一批植物？
cue: Move the young seedlings beneath the shelter. Leave a small gap for air.
cue_options: 大株移进遮棚，留通气缝
幼苗移进遮棚，盖严全部缝
幼苗移进遮棚，留通气缝
sentence: Move the young plants beneath the shelter.
